meta.title: Dooster | Websites and digital marketing from one team | UK
meta.description: Dooster builds websites and runs the marketing around them: content, social media, SEO and AI search visibility. One UK team for small companies that need their website to bring in leads.

hero.label: Web development and digital marketing, UK
hero.heading: Your website and your marketing, run by one team.
hero.lede: We build the website, write the content, post on social, check how you show up on Google and in AI tools like ChatGPT, and keep making changes until it brings in enquiries. You don't need a developer, a writer and a marketer on staff. You've got us.

story.heading: Why we started Dooster
story.pull: Marketing teams couldn't change the website. Tech teams didn't know what to put on it.
paragraphs: Dooster started out of frustration with both sides.

Digital marketing teams often don't understand the technology behind a website. They can plan a campaign, but they can't fix a slow page, add structured data or work out why Google isn't picking up a new service page.

Technology companies have the opposite problem. The product is good, but the website doesn't explain it in terms buyers care about, social media is an afterthought, and nobody checks whether the company comes up when someone asks ChatGPT for a recommendation.
Small companies get hit hardest. Even when someone knows what needs doing, there's no time or budget for it: writing the content, posting every week, auditing the site, making the changes.

So we put those skills under one roof. The people who build your website also write for it, post about it and measure it, with one goal: make the website the main place your leads and sales come from.

services.heading: What we do
services.lede: Most clients use several of these at once. That's the idea: nothing gets lost between a web agency and a marketing agency.

practice.heading: What that looks like week to week

entries.body: We write the page, add the structured data, publish it, post about it and set up tracking, all in the same week.
We look at the analytics, find the page that stopped working and change it. You get a fix, not a report about the problem.

entries.lead: A buyer asks ChatGPT who to use.
entries.body: We test the questions your customers ask every month and work on whatever is stopping you from being mentioned.
We do the writing, posting and site updates. You check and approve them.

check.heading: Not sure where to start?
check.body: Run our free AI visibility check on your site. It looks at up to 10 pages and emails you a score with the fixes that matter most.

cta.heading: Tell us what your website should be doing for you
cta.body: Send a few lines about your business and where things are stuck. We'll reply within a working day with what we'd do first.
